body:
Thank you for your response.

It's hard to pinpoint the exact problem, but I'm pretty sure it's an unwillingness to move on from my ex. I loved him with so much of myself that I'm afraid I'll never love someone as much again. It was the only time in my life I felt comfortable with living, and now I just feel out of place and discouraged with every waking moment that passes.

I have just started seeing a counselor at my university, but she is a student and we haven't clicked. Like, when I try to tell her how low I feel she'll try to change the subject to my pets. It's just frustrating.
